name: RiConnect
description:
RiConnect is the compliance infrastructure for OSHA & HSE - built for high-risk and highly regulated industries. It connects manufacturers, distributors, asset owners, operators, and inspectors within one unified digital ecosystem through cloud-based lifecycle management, RFID integration, and real-time traceability.

With the RiConnect connector, Claude can directly access your live workspace data across four modules:

* Asset Management - retrieve asset details, maintenance records, calibration checks, inspection results, certificates, and pre-use check records.

* Inspection - query contracts, jobs, orders, statements, and hosted assets managed by inspection companies.

* Rental - view rented and received assets, delivery notes, booking history, and utilization metrics.

* Manufacturing - browse products, worksheets, and product units across your manufacturing workflows.

Use Claude to summarize compliance status, identify overdue inspections, cross-reference maintenance and rental records, or generate operational reports — keeping your assets compliant, connected, and operational.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RiConnect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RiConnect to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://login.riconnect.tech/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RiConnect MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RiConnect lists 22 MCP tools, including asset_get_asset, asset_list_assets, asset_list_calibration_checks, asset_list_inspection_results, asset_list_maintenance_records, asset_list_multi_certs, asset_list_preuse_check_records, inspection_list_contracts, inspection_list_hosting_assets, inspection_list_jobs, inspection_list_orders, and inspection_list_statements.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RiConnect?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RiConnect in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
RiConnect requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
RiConnect is developed by RiConnect, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
